title: Ademption
summary: ADEMP'TION, noun [Latin adimo, to take away; of ad and emo, to take.] In the civil law, the revocation of a grant, donation, or the like.

inlines.v: ADEMP'TION, noun [Latin adimo, to take away; of ad and emo, to take.] In the civil law, the revocation of a grant, donation, or the like.
